requirement_text.REQ-006:
Depends on REQ-005 (done — merged into this run's branch), which added 'kk' to src/i18n/routing.ts and seeded messages/kk.json with every messages/ru.json key populated with a Russian-duplicated placeholder value (including Metadata.ogLocale seeded as the placeholder 'ru_RU'). This requirement replaces every placeholder in messages/kk.json with actual Kazakh copy, following docs/guides/content_ba_guide.md's voice/casing/vocabulary rules (§2's seven voice principles, §4's casing) applied to Kazakh prose, and sets Metadata.ogLocale to 'kk_KZ'. Scope covers every string in messages/kk.json (177 keys, mirroring the Metadata + 12 landing-component namespaces).

Script decision (explicit, not copied from REQ-002's Uzbek precedent): Kazakh copy uses CYRILLIC script, not Latin. Kazakhstan's Latin-script transition remains incomplete in practice — Cyrillic is what the large majority of the site's actual Kazakh-reading audience currently reads fluently day-to-day (government, education, media). This differs from REQ-002's Uzbek decision, where Latin is Uzbekistan's actual completed official standard since the 1990s — the two locales are not analogous and REQ-002's Latin choice is not extended here.

Domain vocabulary decision (same pattern as REQ-002/REQ-004, restated for this locale): content_ba_guide.md §4's domain vocabulary terms — Event, Chapter, Talk, Speaker, CFP, Agenda, Check-in, Going, Watching — STAY IN ENGLISH VERBATIM in the Kazakh copy, exactly as they already do in Russian, Uzbek, and English copy. These are established cross-locale product/brand terms, not general vocabulary to translate. Surrounding sentence structure, headings, and connecting prose around these terms are still fully translated into Kazakh.

task.description: Per docs/agents/decisions/0002-content-ba-owns-message-catalogs.md: this is a pure content-writing task against an already-built structure (REQ-005 merged), so CODE-DESIGNER/CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR are skipped as inapplicable. Write real Cyrillic-script Kazakh copy directly into messages/kk.json, replacing every Russian-duplicated placeholder, gated next by REVIEWER (not CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR). Follow content_ba_guide.md's voice/casing/vocabulary rules exactly, and this requirement's own script decision (Cyrillic, not Latin) and domain-vocabulary decision (verbatim English domain terms, no synonym substitution) above. This is a genuinely new-language translation task, not a copy-edit — draft real, natural Kazakh prose, not a mechanical transliteration of the Russian.
acceptance_criteria: Every string key in messages/kk.json has a non-empty value that is not byte-for-byte identical to the corresponding messages/ru.json value, except where a key's value consists solely of an untranslatable literal — event/date codes, country/role/brand names, URLs, numeric values, proper product names, or the content_ba_guide.md §4 domain-vocabulary terms — which are permitted to match verbatim
messages/kk.json's Metadata.ogLocale value is exactly "kk_KZ" (not the placeholder "ru_RU")

Every messages/kk.json value uses Cyrillic-script Kazakh, verified by the presence of Kazakh-specific Cyrillic-extension code points (Ә, Ғ, Қ, Ң, Ө, Ұ, Ү, Һ, І and lowercase forms) appearing somewhere across the file — confirming genuine Kazakh, not a Russian-Cyrillic duplicate left in place — with no Latin-script prose sentences present (the sole exception being verbatim English domain-vocabulary tokens and untranslatable literals)

The status-label keys (Streams.tsx's stream{N}Status keys and MapSection.tsx's chapter{N}Status keys) hold plain lowercase Cyrillic-script Kazakh (or the verbatim English domain term) values, matching the lowercase convention already used in messages/ru.json/uz.json/en.json
No exclamation marks, slogans, or emoji appear in any messages/kk.json value

result.summary: Wrote genuine Cyrillic-script Kazakh copy for all 177 messages/kk.json keys, replacing every Russian-duplicated placeholder. Set Metadata.ogLocale to 'kk_KZ'. Domain-vocabulary terms (Event, Chapter, Talk, Speaker, CFP, Agenda, Check-in, Going, Watching) kept verbatim in English per the requirement's decision. Status-label keys (stream{N}Status, chapter{N}Status) hold lowercase Kazakh values (e.g. 'белсенді', 'жоспарда', 'жұмыс істейді', 'жұмыста'). Self-check script confirmed: key parity with ru.json (177/177, no missing/extra), no empty values, valid JSON, Kazakh-specific letters (Ә/Ғ/Қ/Ң/Ө/Ұ/Ү/Һ/І) present throughout, no exclamation marks or emoji. Two initial translation misses caught and fixed during self-check: Nav.team/Team.eyebrow ('Команда' -> 'Ұжым'), MapSection.eyebrow ('География' -> 'Орналасу'), Streams.stream4Title ('Акселератор' -> 'Үдеткіш'), and Partners.partner4Kind ('трансляция · UZ' left untranslated -> 'хабар тарату · UZ'). All remaining ru/kk identical values verified as permitted literals: person names, English role titles (Founder Global, Co-founder, Board, Country Lead), country/role codes (UZ, UAE, KZ), event date-codes (MEETUP #1 · 25.04.2026 etc.), city name labels (identical Cyrillic spelling in both languages), numeric metric values, and brand/license/URL tokens (AI Qadam Build, build.aiqadam.org, MIT, CC BY 4.0, #AIQadam, Telegram handle).
